reference_origin: Frozen native checked-projection acceptance. Its source save/load assertion compares payload, insertion order, curve shapes and every material field before projection. The native report contains no limit settings; this adapter uses wider admitting ceilings. No fixture generation or physical simulation is part of adapter acceptance.

fixture_storage.format: single gzip member, level 9, empty filename, mtime 0; canonical base64 ASCII plus LF
fixture_storage.scope: Test-only storage. Decoded bytes retain the original source and native report identities above; this is not a runtime protocol format.
